about_the_game:
Game Diary Plus is an add-on that extends the capabilities of your Game Diary, allowing you to organize and track your gaming experience even more conveniently.

Game Diary Plus features:

  • Import games from your Steam library. Instantly add all your Steam games to the list, automatically loading the title and icon.

  • Track Steam achievements. View and insert achievement icons directly into your game notes.

  • Custom game statuses. Create your own statuses to flexibly label and sort your games according to your personal criteria.

  • Custom background for notes. Set a unique background for each game's notes to make your diary even more enjoyable and personalized.

  • Display game progress in percentage. Indicate how much percent of each game is completed, and this indicator will be displayed directly in your list.

  • Game difficulty indicator.

  • Quickly add the current date and time to your notes with a single button.

  • Display information about how many days have passed since the last game launch.

Game Diary Plus makes your game diary more convenient, flexible and personalized by providing powerful additional tools.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent AMD processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics compatible with Windows
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Game Diary Plus is an add-on that opens up new possibilities for your game diary: importing games and achievements from Steam, creating your own statuses, displaying progress in percentage, custom note backgrounds, and other useful features for gamers.
